svg.data-weight-note: 22.7 lb (10.3 kg) chassis, with the power supplies and fan trays installed (guide Table 4); the datasheet says 23.15 lb (10.5 kg) fully loaded
svg.data-depth-note: 18.5 in (47 cm), or 20.43 in (51.89 cm) with the fan tray and power supply handles (guide Table 4)
svg.data-width-note: 19 in (48.26 cm) with the brackets in the guide, 17.6 in (44.7 cm) in the datasheet; the body is modelled
svg.data-switching-capacity: up to 400 Gbps throughput (guide, EX9251 Switch Hardware Overview); the datasheet says up to 800 Gbps
svg.data-sfp-plus-speeds: 10 GbE on each of the eight SFP+ ports
svg.data-rate-selectable-speeds: 100, 40 or 10 GbE on each QSFP28 port; 4 x 10 GbE with a breakout cable
svg.data-wire-speed-density: 24 x 10 GbE, 4 x 40 GbE or 4 x 100 GbE at wire speed (datasheet, Table 4)
svg.data-power-envelope-note: fully loaded switch; 240 W typical at 25 C, 280 W maximum at 55 C (guide Table 12)
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 240 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz; 3.2 A at 100 VAC, 1.37 A at 240 VAC; system input power 312 W
svg.data-power-input-dc: operating -44 to -72 VDC, nominal -48 and -60 VDC; 20 A at -44 VDC maximum; system input power 331 W
svg.data-power-datasheet-max-w: 300 W on AC and 312 W on DC (datasheet Table 3)
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, 1+1 feed redundancy; one supply carries the maximum configuration
svg.data-thermal-output: 1705 BTU/hour (500 W) maximum in the guide's Table 20; 1,275 BTU/hour (360 W) in the datasheet
svg.data-fans: three fan trays, each with one counter-rotating fan, and a fan in each supply
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 90 percent noncondensing in operation; the datasheet gives 5 to 95 percent non-operating
svg.data-altitude: up to 10,000 ft (3,048 m) with no performance degradation
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10 GbE SFP+ transceivers and direct attach copper cables
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: QSFP28 and QSFP+ transceivers; a QSFP28 port runs as 100 GbE, 40 GbE or 4 x 10 GbE
svg.data-ptp: the GM/PTP grandmaster clock port; support is not available in the release the guide covers
svg.data-usb: one USB port for installing Junos OS
svg.data-clock-and-time-io: BITS RJ-45, ToD RJ-45, 1PPS and 10MHz SMB in and out, GM/PTP SFP
svg.data-emc: FCC 47 CFR Part 15 Class A, EN 55022, VCCI, BSMI CNS 13438, AS/NZS CISPR22 (datasheet)
svg.data-nebs: SR-3580 NEBS Criteria Level 3, GR-63-Core, GR-1089-Core (as the datasheet lists them)
